description: This file defines a route for the frontend application that handles user authentication checks and redirects accordingly. It uses Remix framework's loader function to enforce authentication and redirects to either '/notes' or '/login'. It also exports a default React component, which renders nothing.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Performs an authentication check using requireUser and redirects the user to the '/notes' page if authenticated, or '/login' otherwise.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: A React component that renders nothing, acting as the default export for the route.
